decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service builds on the firm's owned fibre infrastructure and moved up to the home page in 2019, so its results appear to meet aspirations, and its fit with the high-bandwidth strategy gives management no reason to start problemistic search.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost software tool that supports the established voice business, and a growing firm has enough slack to carry it, although its modest visibility and the decline of legacy voice products such as E and F leave some risk it will be folded into other offerings.
